text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry. I let my guard down...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see... I have a dinner party 
coming up soon. I was just thinking about 
what outfit to coordinate for it.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I kept the base an elegant blue, and 
tested out where white accents would shine 
best. Before I knew it, I had tried every 
combination...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
What a blunder... I really want to scold 
yesterday's self.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina seemed to have barely slept, 
having been so absorbed in coordinating 
her outfit.
